company.name: Flyflow
company.shortDescription: Flyflow is a AI copilot that enables companies to find prospective customers using AI workflows.
company.description: Flyflow offers an AI-based tool that helps sales teams find and qualify business leads. The system can create lists of companies that match lead qualification criteria. It includes a lookalike search feature that identifies companies similar to existing customers. The product integrates with CRM platforms, including Salesforce and HubSpot, to organize lead information. The service also supports scaling outbound efforts with researched and filtered lead lists.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven platform that automates the process of finding and qualifying prospective customers based on user-defined criteria.
productsAndServices.name: Flyflow AI Copilot
